Rights: Exact Figshare asset metadata and primary article state CC BY4.0. Source attribution, original bytes, literal tables and extraction receipts are retained; no source code or inferential analysis was executed.

Admission: One study information adapter and four alternative published aggregate tables are admitted. Zero new molecular profiles, physical-cell roster rows, geometry objects, same-cell joins, atlas registrations, M2 or M4 admissions are created.

Physical Cell And Cell To Animal Roster · NOT ESTABLISHED: The retained aggregate tables have no individually identified cell roster or cell-to-animal mapping; n=171 denotes recorded neuronal observations, not 171 animals.
Individual Age And Sex · NOT ESTABLISHED: 8–25 weeks is the study preparation range. Individual observation ages and sex are not provided in the retained article methods/tables.
Raw Electrophysiology Traces In Adapter Scope · NOT BUNDLED: No raw ABF or source trace is retained in this aggregate adapter scope; no synthetic or reconstructed trace is substituted.
Physiology Group Molecular Equivalence · NOT ESTABLISHED: Reporter/firing/k/H groups are source analytical partitions, not new canonical molecular types or genetic lineage assignments.
Geometry Internal Structure And Registration · NOT ADMITTED: No observed morphology, soma boundary, internal object, source anatomical coordinates or atlas transform is established by these aggregate tables.
Cross Source Identity · NOT ESTABLISHED: Study aggregate and group identifiers do not establish physical-cell identity or a link to another source.
Printed Fahp And Fi Units · SOURCE UNIT NOT PRINTED: Normalized fAHP amplitude and F/I slope have no printed table units; missing units remain null.
Attributed Source Statements · SOURCE STATEMENTS HELD: The printed Cm = Rin/τ expression is not used to recompute values. The six-positive versus four-listed k-group count remains unresolved; no assignments are filled.

It preserves four alternative partitions of one 171-recorded-observation pool (143 Shox2 and 28 Chx10), 192 literal mean ± SD summaries and 48 source comparisons, with original table labels/units/locators, separate 51-Shox2-mouse and 6-Chx10-mouse context, and prior-study reuse of 60 Shox2 recordings from 28 of those 51 mice as a subset.
